name: Ind Renewable Energy Limited
about: Ind Renewable Energy Limited engages in the generation and sale of solar power in India. It also invests in shares, stocks, bonds, debentures, and other securities of various listed companies. The company was formerly known as Vakharia Power Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to Ind Renewable Energy Limited. Ind Renewable Energy Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Mumbai, India.
